Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result

Class ExecutionHistory

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result.ExecutionHistory
public class ExecutionHistory extends Object
Tracks the execution history of action chains and composite actions. Maintains a record of all steps performed during action execution.

This class encapsulates execution history functionality that was previously embedded in ActionResult.

Since:
2.0
